name: Friendship With The World
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that believers are called to live distinctly from the world, as Jesus chose them out of it and the world consequently hates them (John 15:19). Christians must resist conforming to worldly patterns and instead be transformed by renewing their minds to discern God's perfect will (Romans 12:2). Genuine faith involves remaining unspotted by the world, avoiding the lusts and conflicts that arise from worldly desires (James 1:27; James 4:1). Importantly, friendship with the world is identified as enmity against God, making those who align with worldly values enemies of God (James 4:4).
